{{Short description|Empirical research method}}
'''Quantitative psychological research''' is psychological research that employs [[Quantitative research|quantitative research methods]].<ref>{{cite journal|last=Smith|first=K.|title=Quantitative versus Qualitative Research: An Attempt to Clarify the Issue|journal=Educational Researcher|date=March 1983|volume=12|issue=3|pages=6–13|jstor=1175144|doi=10.3102/0013189x012003006|s2cid=143949102 }}</ref>

Quantitative research falls under the category of [[empirical studies|empirical research]].<ref>{{cite book|last=Newman, Benz|first=I., C.|title=Qualitative-Quantitative Research Methodology: Exploring the Interactive Continuum|publisher=Southern Illinois University|year=1998|pages=9–10}}</ref>
